strategy.selection_reason: Selected over excluded static realized-volatility, range, ACF-clustering, and Markov-switching candidates because the captured MDPI cryptocurrency study explicitly evaluates GJR-GARCH volatility modeling, while the official arch documentation provides the asymmetric negative-shock recursion. The OHLC-only regime mapping, entries, exits, and execution layer are deterministic project-derived and not attributed to source performance.
entry_logic: At each newly closed bar, compute r_t=ln(C_t/C_{t-1}) and update the deterministic GJR recursion from prior closed-bar state.

Classify volatility regime from sigma_t / EMA(sigma_t): GREED when ratio >= InpVolRegimeThreshold and r_t>0; FEAR when ratio >= threshold and r_t<0; NEUTRAL when ratio<threshold and abs(r_t) <= InpNeutralReturnBand; EXTREME_FEAR when ratio >= InpExtremeVolThreshold and r_t<0.
Enter long on closed-bar positive return with regime-specific multiplier mapping when no position exists; enter short on closed-bar negative return under the corresponding regime.
exit_logic: Attach ATR-based stop and take-profit at entry using the active regime SL/TP multipliers.
Exit on opposite closed-bar signal or stop/take-profit; one position per symbol.
filters: Closed-bar-only OHLC validity and finite-price checks.
Warmup requires max(InpGJROrder, InpGJRLookback, InpATRPeriod)+1 bars.
Regime states are mutually exclusive by priority EXTREME_FEAR > GREED/FEAR > NEUTRAL.

warmup.initialization: Initialize sigma2 from the first lookback return variance, set g=ln(max(sigma2,1e-12)), and skip signals until warmup is complete.

closed_bar_policy.description: Only completed OHLC bars are read and evaluated once per new bar.

equations: The official arch documentation gives the GJR-GARCH variance recursion with an indicator for negative shocks: sigma^2_t = omega + alpha epsilon^2_(t-1) + gamma epsilon^2_(t-1) I[epsilon_(t-1)<0] + beta sigma^2_(t-1); this supports the implementation form.
vol_ratio=sigma_t/EMA(sigma_t,InpGJRLookback); classify mutually exclusive regimes by priority.

regimes.classification: priority EXTREME_FEAR, then GREED or FEAR by return sign, else NEUTRAL; vol_ratio=sigma/EMA(sigma,InpGJRLookback).

signals.long: r_t>0 and no open position after regime classification
signals.short: r_t<0 and no open position after regime classification
signals.conflict_policy: If both signals are unavailable or data is invalid, skip the trade.

exits.stop_loss: Entry price plus/minus ATR_t*InpStopATRMult*active regime SL multiplier.
exits.take_profit: Entry price plus/minus ATR_t*InpTakeProfitATRMult*active regime TP multiplier.
exits.time_stop: No time stop; exits are only stop, target, or opposite closed-bar signal.

execution.margin_check: Require sufficient free margin before order.
execution.volume_normalization: Normalize calculated volume to broker min, max, and step.
execution.minimum_take_profit: Reject orders whose target violates broker minimum distance.
